request: Make app.use() without an explicit path attach middleware to the current path rather than *, so a nearby route declaration controls its scope.

source.request: Make app.use() without an explicit path attach middleware to the current path rather than *, so a nearby route declaration controls its scope.
source.settled: When app.use receives middleware as its first argument, its default path is *.
source.why: Using the current path would reverse the all-path default for pathless middleware registration.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
